name: wows-omp-plugin-audit-goal
description: Goal-driven audit-and-fix loop with a round ledger, intensity levels, and reserved audit agents

intensity.description: Audit depth and gate: relaxed reports visible problems and fixes Critical/Major; standard requires credible production triggers and also fixes Minor; strict digs into toolchain and dependency boundaries and fixes every level

maxRounds.description: Default maximum audit rounds per /audit loop; empty means unlimited. When reached, you are asked whether to add rounds

maxParallelLanes.description: Maximum audit/fix subagents running at once; empty means no plugin limit. OMP's task.maxConcurrency always caps it
